verdicts.reason: A reads well as a banner: one-line italic headline, source and rating on a single row beneath it, legible logo on the right. But the text block starts about 160px in, leaving dead space on the left, the opening quote mark is shrunk to a speck, and the logo is small and floats far from the copy. B shrinks the OBSIDIAN logo to an illegible fleck at the far left, so the brand is effectively lost. Its three text lines are jammed together, the source line is nearly as heavy as the headline, and the right half of the canvas sits empty, which leaves the layout lopsided.
